# Explainer Motion · Riley Brown

> Motion graphics for Riley Brown's videos: ten topic explainers plus fourteen B-roll templates (text cards, video inserts, logo cards, screens and name labels over A-roll), built with HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP) and rendered to 1920x1080 MP4. Every entry ships notes, a recreation prompt, keywords, tags and the full composition source.

Source: https://github.com/rbrown101010/explainer-motion

## Start here
- [Style guide](/style.md): palette, type, shapes, motion and HyperFrames rules shared by every entry
- [Index (JSON)](/data/explainers.json): every entry with notes, prompt, keywords, tags and file paths
- Live player: /play.html?id=<slug> runs any composition in a normal browser.
- Search: /?q=<words> opens the gallery with a query; `tag:Riley1` filters by tag.

## Tags
- Riley1: Riley's dark #212120 + Geist + coral style (all entries today)

## How to replicate for a new video
1. Read /style.md.
2. Search the index for the closest entry to what you want to show and read its notes.md.
3. Copy its composition and assets, swap the logos, footage, words and timing, keep the style rules.
4. Run `npx hyperframes check .` then `npx hyperframes render . -q high -o renders/video.mp4`.
